rows.label: Capital gains tax on Cyprus immovable property; flat tax on crypto-asset gains (Φόρος Κεφαλαιουχικών Κερδών) [national]
rows.value: 20% on gains from Cyprus immovable property (lifetime exemptions €30,000 general, €150,000 principal residence, €50,000 farmland from 2026); 8% on crypto-asset gains; profits from the sale of securities exempt. Paid by individuals and companies disposing of Cyprus immovable property or shares in companies holding it; individuals with crypto-asset gains. Capital Gains Tax Law 52/1980; Income Tax Law 118(I)/2002 art. 20E.

rows.label: Rental income and pension income (Εισόδημα από ενοίκια και συντάξεις) [national]
rows.value: rent taxed at the income tax scale; special defence contribution on rent abolished from 2026; foreign pensions taxed at the scale or, by choice, 5% on the amount above €5,000 a year. Paid by landlords and pensioners. Income Tax Law 118(I)/2002; Special Defence Contribution (Amending) (No. 4) Law 2025.

rows.label: Carbon tax on transport fuels: none (legislation suspended) [national]
rows.value: None in 2026: the legal acts introducing a carbon tax on transport fuels (with higher water fees and a landfill charge), due to enter into force by 31 October 2025, are suspended. Paid by no one. Ministry of Finance, 2026 Annual Progress Report, Green Taxation reform commitments.
